description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 5 July 2019 with three TAG TEAMs that pair a Kanto starter Pokémon with a later one: Venusaur & Snivy-GX, Charizard & Braixen-GX and Blastoise & Piplup-GX, joined by Alolan Persian-GX. For its release, sealed-deck tournaments ran at Pokémon Card Gym events in July and August 2019, with a Hyper Rare Mewtwo-GX limited to 300 copies worldwide as the prize. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 64, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare cards, the TAG TEAMs in two versions each, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Great Catcher, Martial Arts Dojo and Draw Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Cosmic Eclipse in November 2019.
